description: FRET-restrained rigid-body docking, refinement, structure-library screening and error estimation using IMP + IMP.bff accessible volumes (a thin shim around IMP.pmi).

rpc_methods.name: fret.info_backends
rpc_methods.description: Report whether the IMP / IMP.bff backends are available.

rpc_methods.name: fret.refine

rpc_methods.name: fret.score
rpc_methods.description: Score a single structure against the FRET restraints.

rpc_methods.name: fret.screen
rpc_methods.description: Score and rank a structure library.

rpc_methods.name: fret.estimate_errors
rpc_methods.description: Estimate docking errors from repeated trials.
